narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. The ghost's money touched its lowest in month {ghost_lowest_month}. The layoff came for both in month {layoff_month}, the month the money stood furthest apart, and at its close the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. The ghost's days held a little more living, its Life {life_gap}.
